title: Four-vectors and the Lorentz group
summary: The Minkowski inner product and the Lorentz group Λᵀ η Λ = η; its dimension and components; four-vectors by transformation law; four-velocity and four-acceleration with their invariants; raising and lowering indices.

objectives.description: Objectives will be finalised when the unit is prepared; the source material is Tong, Dynamics and Relativity, Sections 7.3.2 and 7.4, Spacetime Physics Section 7.2, and MIT 8.20 Week 3 (Lectures 8.1–8.3).

preparation.description: Read Tong, Dynamics and Relativity, Section 7.3 The Geometry of Spacetime, especially 7.3.2 The Lorentz Group (reference-only; signature (+,−,−,−)).
Read Tong, Section 7.4 Relativistic Kinematics: 7.4.1 Proper Time and 7.4.7 Indices Up, Indices Down (reference-only).
Read Spacetime Physics Chapter 7, Section 7.2 Momenergy Arrow (pp. 191–195), for the book's four-vector picture.
